name: Camping 101: Cooking

angles.text: Learning basic cooking provides the fundamental knowledge needed to build a campfire, establishing the central anchor for any wilderness camp.

faq.answer: It is an introductory wilderness instruction that teaches adventurers how the art of cooking and lighting basic campfires serves as the foundation for setting up a campsite.
Zerril Softbreeze is a cooking trainer situated in Shen'dar Village who instructs novices in the basic culinary arts and how to start a campfire.
Cooking teaches adventurers how to build and maintain a campfire, which acts as the core foundation around which any wilderness campsite is established.
faq.q: Why is cooking required to set up a camp?

faq.answer: Zerril Softbreeze can be found teaching tradeskills within Shen'dar Village.
Novices can place basic furnishings around their campfires, but learning trade skills from other craft trainers allows adventurers to craft and set up additional campsite furnishings.
By advancing your cooking skill, you can learn how to kindle even larger campfires to improve your wilderness camps.

sections.body: For an adventurer traveling across untamed lands, understanding survival begins with the hearth. Camping 101: Cooking introduces wanderers to the art of culinary craft, not merely for preparing meals, but because mastering a basic fire is the essential first step to establishing a safe resting spot in the wild.
sections.title: The Hearth of the Wild

sections.body: Aspiring campers are directed to speak with Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village to learn the fundamentals of the cooking trade. Once an adventurer understands how to kindle a campfire, they gain the ability to establish a small campsite anywhere across the wilderness. Although rudimentary camps support only minimal furnishings, improving one's craft allows for larger fires and richer arrangements crafted with aid from other tradeskills.
sections.title: Foundations of the Campsite

summary: Camping 101: Cooking is an introductory quest that teaches adventurers the culinary arts as the vital foundation for wilderness survival. By learning to start a campfire from Zerril Softbreeze in Shen'dar Village, travelers unlock the ability to pitch their own campsites in the wild.
